Base cell class for segmentation and coverage path planning.

class CellBase(idx: int, poly: Polygon, resolution: float = 0.05, simplify: bool = True)

Bases: object

Base cell representation for decomposed workspace regions.

This class provides the fundamental structure for cells created during space segmentation, storing geometric properties and adjacency information.

Parameters:

  • idx (int) -- Unique identifier for the cell.

  • poly (Polygon) -- Shapely polygon defining the cell boundary.

  • resolution (float) -- Map resolution in meters per pixel.

  • simplify (bool) -- Whether to simplify the polygon upon creation.

covpp.segmentation.cell_planning module

Processed cell class with advanced geometric analysis for coverage planning.

class PCell(cell: CellBase, zmd: ZoneMapData)

Bases: CellBase

Enhanced cell with geometric analysis for optimal coverage planning.

Extends the base Cell class to include: - Binary map representation of the cell area - Rectangle-like property evaluation (circumscribed and inscribed) - Main direction extraction using Hough Transform.

covpp.segmentation.eval_rectangles module

Module for evaluating rectangle-like properties of polygons for planning optimization.

class EvalRectangles(cell_id: int, poly: Polygon, r_px: int)

Bases: object

Evaluate cell for rectangle-like properties to optimize planning.

Pipeline Steps:

  1. Evaluate based on circumscribed rectangle (minimum_rotated_rectangle)

  2. Create base inscribed rectangle from maximum inscribed circle

  3. Expand inscribed rectangle in multiple directions

  4. Set rectangle-like property based on evaluation results

simplify_polygon(tol) → None

Simplify the cell polygon to reduce number of vertices.

eval_by_circumscribed_rect(circum_rect_area) → None

Evaluate if the cell is rectangle-like based on the area ratio of the cell and the circumscribed rectangle.

create_base_inscribed_rectangle(circum_rect_poly, insc_circle_center, insc_circle_radius) → Polygon

Create an inscribed rectangle inside the circumscribed rectangle of the cell based on the inscribed circle.

eval_by_expand_inscribed_rectangle(base_inscribed_rect_poly: Polygon, insc_circle_center) → Polygon

Evaluate the inscribed rectangle by comparing it three expanded inscribed rectangles.

expand_inscribed_rectangle_1(inscribed_rect_poly: Polygon, insc_circle_center) → Polygon

Expand the base inscribed rectangle. Keep expanding in each direction till collision, then move to next direction.

expand_inscribed_rectangle_2(inscribed_rect_poly: Polygon, insc_circle_center) → Polygon

Expand the base inscribed rectangle. First find the main direction of expansion buy expanding in each direction separately till collision, then expand in that direction and then in the other directions.

expand_inscribed_rectangle_3(inscribed_rect_poly: Polygon) → Polygon

Expand the base inscribed rectangle. Expand based on the biggest edge of the base rectangle.

expand two points p1 and p2 in the direction of angle theta by step and check if the new points are inside the polygon.

covpp.segmentation.segmentation_base module

Base class for segmentation algorithms.

This module defines the abstract interface that all segmentation methods must implement, enabling a plugin-based architecture.

class SegmentationBase(zmd: ZoneMapData, map_polygons: MapPolygons)

Bases: object

Abstract base class for zone segmentation algorithms.

Process expected from subclasses:

  1. Inspect self.zmd and self.map_polygons to decide how to split the zone.

  2. Populate self.cells with CellBase instances.

  3. Set adjacency information and self.n_cells for downstream planners.

Result:

cells (list[CellBase]) fully describing the decomposition ready to be wrapped into PCell objects.

Parameters:

  • zmd (ZoneMapData) -- Zone map data object.

  • map_polygons (MapPolygons) -- Polygon representation of workspace and obstacles.

cells

List of cells created by segmentation.

Type:

list[CellBase]

n_cells

Number of cells created.

Type:

int

zmd

Zone map data object.

Type:

ZoneMapData

map_polygons

Polygon representation of the workspace.

Type:

MapPolygons

run()

Execute the segmentation algorithm.

This method must be implemented by all child classes. It should decompose the zone workspace into cells and populate the cells and n_cells attributes.

create_cells()

Create CellBase objects for each segmented cell.

set_cell_adjacents()

Set adjacent cells for each cell based on shared boundaries or other criteria.

covpp.segmentation.segmentation_handler module

Segmentation handler module for managing zone decomposition into cells.

This module implements the Handler pattern to dynamically load and execute different segmentation algorithms based on configuration.

class SegmentationHandler(zmd: ZoneMapData)

Bases: object

High-level interface for zone segmentation into coverage cells.

This handler dynamically loads the appropriate segmentation algorithm based on the pipeline configuration and converts raw cells into processed cells ready for coverage planning.

Result:

cells (list[PCell])

Parameters:

zmd (ZoneMapData) -- Zone map data object.

Processed cells ready for planning.

Type:

n_cells

Number of cells created.

Type:

int

Supported Methods:

  • "simple": Single cell covering entire zone

  • "voronoi": Voronoi-based decomposition

  • Custom methods can be added by extending SegmentationBase

run() → None

Execute segmentation pipeline using configured method.

This method:

  1. Loads the segmentation algorithm based on configuration

  2. Executes the segmentation to create base cells

  3. Converts base cells to planning cells (PCell objects) by processing and merging

  4. Validates the created cells for planning readiness

Raises:

ValueError -- If segmentation method is not recognized.

process_cells() → None

Convert base cells from segmentor into planning PCell objects.

validate_cells() → None

Validate the created cells for planning readiness.
